Under SRC_001's logic, every connection attempt costs tokens (conjecture generation, criticism, adjudication); an artifact that resists connection may be performing implicit token optimization by refusing to engage in connections that would exhaust the repertoire without producing epistemic gain. The compatibility holds because both the isolated artifact and the token-economy framework value epistemic efficiency over connection quantity. REFUTED IF the artifact's isolation has no resource-conservation implication — e.g., if it persists despite zero token cost for connection attempts, or if connecting it would conserve tokens rather than burn them.
